QuestInfo.name: Dehydrated Trees
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies has another favor to ask you. Better see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies said that Stumps are starting to dry out. She wanted you to ask Winston in #m 102020400# to find out why this is happening. Science must not be 10 Boogies's specialty.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Winston about why plants in Perion get dehydrated.

0.0: The plants in Perion are slowly drying out. I mean, it's always been dry around here, but those Seedlings you brought turned to dust in a matter of days. It's spooky. I think we should tell Winston in #m102020400#.
0.1: I love Perion, the people of Perion, and even the plants of Perion! I want to protect this land. Please hurry!\r\n#b(You will be moved #m102020400# after you accept.)#k

no.0: This is important! The poor plants are withering away, and it makes Perion look really creepy. We can't have that!

1.0: I say, wish we had a bulldozer for the excavation... Oh, it's you! How may I help you on this fine day?

yes.0: So...the whole of Perion is drying out, eh? Wicked business.

npc.0: Why are you still here? I just told you to tell Winston that Perion is in terrible danger! This is no time to be lazy!
